name: lx_dsh_peek
description: Read-only, no-input, light-themed LAN peek at active DSH and ZCode sessions, plus host-injected font, taller-composer overrides for the official DSH UI (no patched DMG), and an always-on session archive that mirrors the conversation text of every DSH and ZCode session (your questions, assistant prose and reasoning) into the NAS PostgreSQL through /api/dsh/archive — full-log paging, JSONL spool on outage, JWT auto-refresh. HTTP bootstrap for the initial transcript and one multiplexed SSE for live deltas/events, live reasoning and tool calls, reconnect baseline hydration, bounded tail rendering with optional single-text-buffer terminal mode, background-command output, subagent-aware follow, completion flash, screen-wake fallback, 1/2/3/4 panes and orientation-aware layout, and a client face that adds ⌘⇧] / ⌘⇧[ next/previous session switching to the official desktop UI and opens its Think rows by default.
author: llp

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/zcode.js && node --check src/archive.js && node --check src/client.js
scripts.test: node --test tests/server.test.mjs tests/zcode.test.mjs tests/archive.test.mjs tests/archive.integration.test.mjs tests/client.test.mjs
